voiceover_text: A fighter enters grinning. He swings first, misses, and drops his sword. He watches the opponent calmly walk past to ring a bell. The crowd laughs — damn, brutal.
He says the trap cannot fail. The floor opens beneath him. His two friends stare down at him in stunned silence. Nobody moves. The room fills with a heavy, awkward quiet.
The group leaves. A child sits alone. Another child returns, offers a hand, and helps them stand. They take the hand and rise. No fanfare. Just that simple, steady help.
